title: MediaAsset
description: One uploaded file in the admin media library. Distinct from common/media.schema.json, which is the small {url, alt, ...} value embedded inside a project/profile/etc — this is the library entry the admin panel browses, uploads to, and deletes from. Admin-only: visitors never browse the raw library, only the images already embedded in published content.

path.description: Storage object path, e.g. public/media/<id>/original.webp — needed to delete the underlying object, not just the Firestore record.

alt.description: Required before the asset can be referenced elsewhere — enforced by the admin panel, not this schema, since an upload has no alt text yet at the moment it's created.

usageCount.description: Best-effort reference count the admin panel can use to warn before deleting an asset still in use elsewhere.
